description_en: Deletes a historical version of a dataset in a specified agent workspace. After deletion, the version no longer appears in the list returned by ListDatasetVersions. This operation does not delete the dataset itself, the current data, or other historical versions
description_zh: 删除指定智能体空间中某个数据集的历史版本。删除后，该版本不再出现在 ListDatasetVersions 返回的列表中。此操作不会删除数据集本身、当前数据或其他历史版本
kebab_example: aliyun agentloop delete-dataset-version --agent-space my_agent_space --dataset-name product_faq_dataset --biz-version v1 --api-version 2026-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDatasetVersion

parameters.help_en: The name of the agent workspace to which the dataset belongs. Specify the name of an existing agent workspace that you have access to
parameters.help_zh: 数据集所属的智能体空间（AgentSpace）名称。请填写已存在且有权访问的智能体空间名称
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.help_en: The name of the dataset. You can call ListDatasets to retrieve the name. The name must be 4 to 63 characters in length, start with a lowercase letter, and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores. It cannot end with an underscore or contain consecutive underscores
parameters.help_zh: 数据集名称。可调用 ListDatasets 获取。名称长度为 4～63 个字符，以小写字母开头，仅包含小写字母、数字和下划线，不能以下划线结尾或包含连续下划线
parameters.name: dataset_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the historical version to delete. You can call ListDatasetVersions to retrieve the name. The name cannot be empty after leading and trailing spaces are removed, and cannot contain forward slashes (/)
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的历史版本名称，可调用 ListDatasetVersions 获取。去除首尾空白后不能为空，且不能包含正斜线（/）
parameters.name: version

schema.description_en: The response information returned when the request is successful
schema.description_zh: 请求成功时返回的响应信息

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于定位和排查问题
